authority_model: Project Pipeline separates deterministic authority from probabilistic advice. The Project Control Kernel, policy, budget, lease, and completion gates own admissible transitions; AI, provider, and optimization components may recommend or execute only within explicitly granted authority.

components.authority: Transport boundary only; all commands route to the normal control, policy, and audit path.

interfaces_provided.name: Operator API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Versioned HTTP and realtime operator interface

components.name: Control API and Realtime Gateway
components.responsibility: Expose authenticated versioned HTTP, SSE, WebSocket, replay, Director-context, inbox, and typed-control contracts as non-authoritative operator projections.

components.authority: Authoritative for artifact identity and byte integrity; consumers hold references rather than copied blobs.

interfaces_provided.name: Artifact Storage Port
interfaces_provided.purpose: Put, verify, retrieve, retain, and garbage-collect content-addressed artifacts

components.name: Content-Addressed Artifact Store
components.responsibility: Store immutable artifact bytes by SHA-256 with PostgreSQL metadata, local filesystem baseline, reference-aware retention, and optional S3 backend.

components.authority: Independent deterministic Completion Gate authority; worker, model, reviewer, and upstream-tool claims cannot directly transition the project to final completion.

interfaces_provided.name: Verification and Completion API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Plan verification, record findings, and evaluate completion

components.name: Verification Director and Completion Gate
components.responsibility: Compile objective verification criteria, derive affected-behavior test impact, execute the profile-driven verification portfolio and golden journeys, record browser/accessibility/performance/adversarial/property/mutation/fault/post-merge evidence, enforce loop/scope/review/evidence sufficiency controls, challenge lazy completion, localize failures, and authorize final completion only when all convergence questions pass. Broader security, resilience/DR, deployment, lifecycle, and Command Center obligations remain downstream and cannot be hidden by verification success.

components.authority: Authoritative for recovery-objective and restore-verification records; destructive promotion requires recovery and policy authority.

interfaces_provided.name: Backup and Restore Verification Port
interfaces_provided.purpose: Plan backup/restore operations and record separate restore-verification outcomes

components.name: Backup and Restore Verification Controller
components.responsibility: Own domain recovery objectives, backup/restore plans, isolated restore verification status, and recovery evidence without equating backup existence with recovery readiness.

components.authority: Authoritative for spend admission within configured budgets; unknown cost is handled conservatively.

interfaces_provided.name: Budget and Spend Lease API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Forecast, admit, reserve, record, and reconcile cost and quota usage

components.name: Budget Governor
components.responsibility: Account for monetary spend, quotas, subscriptions, local compute, forecasts, spend leases, pressure modes, and cost per verified outcome.

components.authority: Conversational advisory surface only; action execution uses typed commands and normal gates.

interfaces_provided.name: Director Conversation API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Grounded conversational queries and action proposals

components.name: Director Chat
components.responsibility: Provide grounded global/project/incident Director conversation, evidence-backed summaries, and confirmation-required typed action proposals; mutations remain exclusively on normal Control Kernel paths.

components.authority: No canonical project authority by default; cloud witness may fence local failover only under recorded lease policy.

interfaces_provided.name: Cloud Spine Port
interfaces_provided.purpose: Expose optional witness, durable event, recovery storage, and bounded cloud-capacity primitives

components.name: Optional AWS Cloud Spine
components.responsibility: Provide optional witness, durable event transport, recovery storage, observability, budget controls, and bounded recovery/burst support while local control remains primary.

components.authority: Authoritative for issued context-pack identity and receipt validation, not for project state.

interfaces_provided.name: Context Compilation API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Compile, validate, and retrieve context packs and receipts

components.name: Context Broker and Compiler
components.responsibility: Build immutable minimal context packs and receipts from trusted sources, repository maps, plans, acceptance criteria, and current state.

components.authority: Final deterministic authority for project transitions; probabilistic recommendations cannot override it.

interfaces_provided.name: Control Command API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Evaluate typed commands and return authoritative transition results

interfaces_provided.name: Project State Query API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Expose authoritative project state and readiness facts

components.name: Project Control Kernel
components.responsibility: Own canonical project state, admissible transitions, eligibility, dependency truth, assignment truth, and completion recomputation.

components.authority: Deployment operations require explicit environment, policy, authorization, and evidence gates.

interfaces_provided.name: Deployment Control Port
interfaces_provided.purpose: Plan and execute verified profile-aware deployment operations

components.name: Runtime Supervisor and Deployment Profiles
components.responsibility: Install, configure, start, stop, monitor, qualify, upgrade, and roll back local Python, Windows-service/desktop, container, separated environment, and optional AWS runtime profiles while preserving explicit target qualification.

components.authority: Advisory and coordinating authority only; all mutations pass through the Control Kernel, policy, budget, and evidence gates.

interfaces_provided.name: Director Recommendation API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Produce grounded recommendations with rationale and confidence

components.name: Autonomy Director
components.responsibility: Continuously propose priorities, plans, delegations, recovery actions, and escalations using live project state.

components.authority: Authoritative for evidence records; it cannot reinterpret a failed or unknown result as passing.

interfaces_provided.name: Evidence Ledger API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Append and query immutable evidence records

components.name: Evidence Ledger
components.responsibility: Record append-only evidence identities, claims, methods, freshness, results, provenance, and verification status.

components.authority: Computes graph facts from canonical inputs; it does not independently change project state.

interfaces_provided.name: Graph Analysis Port
interfaces_provided.purpose: Graph construction, validation, traversal, critical-path, and conflict queries

components.name: Graph Analysis Service
components.responsibility: Represent dependency, conflict, ownership, and resource graphs and run deterministic graph algorithms.

components.authority: Authoritative for observed intake facts and deterministic compilation artifacts; it may create bounded bootstrap assets only after explicit confirmation, while the Project Control Kernel remains authoritative for accepted project-state transitions.

interfaces_provided.name: Project Intake API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Inspect and compile new or existing project roots into deterministic manifests, profiles, repository maps, and gap reports

interfaces_provided.name: Controlled Bootstrap API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Plan, apply, replay, and roll back bounded non-destructive bootstrap actions

components.name: Project Intake Compiler
components.responsibility: Inspect new or existing project roots without executing discovered code, compile deterministic project manifests, profiles, repository maps, authority inventories, and gap reports, then plan or apply bounded non-destructive bootstrap actions.

components.authority: Local model is authoritative for offline planning; remote authority is profile-specific and reconciliation is explicit.

interfaces_provided.name: Jira Steward API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Query, stage, synchronize, and reconcile work-management state

components.name: Jira Steward
components.responsibility: Maintain the structured local Jira model, synchronize authorized remote changes, reconcile divergence, and preserve source context.

components.authority: Advisory only; never authoritative for project state, recovery fencing, policy, budget, or completion.

interfaces_provided.name: Local Model Runtime Port
interfaces_provided.purpose: Discover, validate, select, and plan advisory requests to qualified local runtimes

components.name: Local Model Gateway
components.responsibility: Register and select local advisory runtimes for offline/degraded assistance while preserving deterministic task and control semantics.

components.authority: Does not change project state by notification alone; acknowledged actions return through Control Kernel commands.

interfaces_provided.name: Notification API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Publish, route, acknowledge, and escalate operator notifications

components.name: Notification Broker and Operator Inbox
components.responsibility: Deterministically prioritize, deduplicate, suppress, route, acknowledge, persist, retry, and audit operator notifications; Tauri local delivery and optional Apprise/ntfy remote adapters remain bounded behind the canonical broker and remote delivery is disabled by default.

components.authority: Observed telemetry is evidence; deterministic health calculations are derived from it and canonical state.

interfaces_provided.name: Telemetry and Health API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Emit correlated telemetry and query calculated health

components.name: Observability and Health Service
components.responsibility: Correlate structured logs, metrics, traces, audit events, workflow, worker, model, context, cost, and health telemetry using OpenTelemetry conventions.

components.authority: Authoritative for event identity and delivery state; external systems remain subject to reconciliation.

interfaces_provided.name: Event Delivery Port
interfaces_provided.purpose: Append, claim, deliver, retry, deduplicate, and reconcile durable messages

components.name: Event, Inbox, and Outbox Service
components.responsibility: Commit domain events, external-write intents, inbound deduplication, retry state, and reconciliation records transactionally with canonical state.

components.authority: Authoritative for application-domain state; workflow engines, UIs, and providers hold projections or execution-specific state only.

interfaces_provided.name: Transactional State Port
interfaces_provided.purpose: Atomic domain state, event, inbox, and outbox operations

components.name: Canonical Persistence
components.responsibility: Persist canonical project, work, requirement, traceability, transition, intake-compilation, bootstrap-receipt, integration-reconciliation, durable-workflow, event, wait, checkpoint, heartbeat, inbox/outbox, and recovery-decision state through PostgreSQL production ports and an executable SQLite local profile.

components.authority: Authoritative for policy decisions; callers enforce allow, deny, require-approval, and constrained results.

interfaces_provided.name: Policy Decision API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Evaluate versioned policy against typed input and return an auditable decision

components.name: Policy Engine
components.responsibility: Evaluate centralized testable runtime authority, action, egress, dependency, deployment, spend, and completion policies.

components.authority: No authority over project truth; outputs are untrusted recommendations until validated.

interfaces_provided.name: Provider Invocation Port
interfaces_provided.purpose: Invoke typed advisory agents and model providers through qualified adapters

components.name: Provider and Advisory Agent Gateway
components.responsibility: Expose typed advisory-agent and provider-neutral model interfaces with schema validation, fallback, cost telemetry, and circuit breaking.

components.authority: May execute pre-authorized recovery actions; destructive or externally sensitive actions require policy and human gates.

interfaces_provided.name: Recovery Control API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Declare incidents, run recovery plans, and verify restored state

components.name: Recovery Director
components.responsibility: Detect incidents, select degraded modes and recovery plans, coordinate failover, preserve WIP, and verify restoration before normal operation resumes.

components.authority: Mutations require Control Kernel authorization and policy approval; worktree mechanics are delegated behind an adapter.

interfaces_provided.name: Repository Steward API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Perform and reconcile authorized repository operations

components.name: Repository Steward
components.responsibility: Own branch, worktree, pull-request, merge-gate, cleanup, WIP-preservation, and Git/GitHub reconciliation mechanics.

components.authority: Authoritative for resource ownership and lease validity.

interfaces_provided.name: Resource Lease API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Register capacity and issue, renew, fence, or release leases

components.name: Resource Registry and Lease Manager
components.responsibility: Track machines, workers, files, worktrees, ports, environments, GPUs, credentials, and bounded fenced leases.

components.authority: May recommend and initiate approved execution but cannot override scheduler, policy, budget, or control decisions.

interfaces_provided.name: Capability Routing API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Resolve a task contract to a qualified execution route

components.name: Capability Router
components.responsibility: Select qualified agents, models, providers, tools, and worker nodes by capability, performance, policy, budget, and availability.

components.authority: Authoritative for admission decisions within policy and budget limits; optimization output is always revalidated deterministically.

interfaces_provided.name: Scheduling API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Simulate and admit conflict-safe work sets

components.name: Dynamic Lane Scheduler
components.responsibility: Choose safe parallel work sets using conflict constraints, resource capacity, leases, backpressure, and optional optimization.

components.authority: Authoritative for credential release; human and agent authority remains policy-controlled.

interfaces_provided.name: Secret Resolution Port
interfaces_provided.purpose: Resolve approved secret references into scoped runtime credentials

components.name: Secrets and Identity Broker
components.responsibility: Resolve secret references and issue least-privilege, task-scoped credentials without exposing secret material to prompts, logs, or source control.

components.authority: Authoritative for graph-derived sequencing facts once inputs are accepted by the Control Kernel.

interfaces_provided.name: Sequencing API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Compute readiness, priority, and critical path

components.name: Build Sequencer
components.responsibility: Maintain validated dependency DAGs, readiness, blockers, priority, critical path, and recomputation after change.

components.authority: Enforces policy decisions but does not define them; mutating calls require typed action intent and scoped credentials.

interfaces_provided.name: Tool Invocation Port
interfaces_provided.purpose: Discover and invoke approved tools with identity, policy, and telemetry

components.name: Tool Gateway
components.responsibility: Register, isolate, authorize, discover, invoke, and observe tools and MCP servers through a stable internal contract.

components.authority: Authoritative for traceability records; it cannot declare implementation complete without evidence.

interfaces_provided.name: Traceability Query API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Resolve relationships in both directions

components.name: Requirement and Traceability Engine
components.responsibility: Maintain source-to-requirement-to-plan-to-work-to-code-to-test-to-evidence mappings with stable identifiers and exact provenance.

components.authority: Read-only by default; actions are explicit commands routed through normal authorization and audit.

interfaces_provided.name: Operator Interface
interfaces_provided.purpose: Desktop and browser operator experience

components.name: Command Center
components.responsibility: Provide accessible Windows-capable and network-accessible views of project health, work, graph, evidence, budgets, providers, context, incidents, and controls.

components.authority: Execution authority is bounded by task, workspace, resource, credential, spend, and time leases.

interfaces_provided.name: Worker Execution Port
interfaces_provided.purpose: Start, observe, interrupt, checkpoint, and recover bounded worker sessions

components.name: Worker Runtime and Node Harness
components.responsibility: Execute approved work in isolated workspaces, stream events, checkpoint progress, and report candidate results without self-declaring completion.

components.authority: Authoritative only for workflow execution history; canonical project truth remains in PostgreSQL and the Control Kernel.

interfaces_provided.name: Durable Workflow Port
interfaces_provided.purpose: Start, signal, query, cancel, resume, and reconcile durable workflows

components.name: Durable Workflow Runtime
components.responsibility: Persist and resume long-running workflow execution, timers, signal waits, retries, checkpoints, cancellation, worker heartbeats/fencing, uncertain-outcome reconciliation, and worker-loss recovery through a Project Pipeline-owned durable state model with Hatchet as the initial optional backend and DBOS/Temporal as qualified fallbacks.

components.authority: Authoritative for lifecycle policy and eligibility decisions only; project control, repository stewardship, budget, security, deployment, and external destructive actions retain their existing authorities and must be invoked through typed audited controls.

interfaces_provided.name: Platform Lifecycle API
interfaces_provided.purpose: Evaluate portfolio, repository, environment, retention, closure, qualification, upgrade, and adoption lifecycle decisions

components.name: Platform Lifecycle and Portfolio Governor
components.responsibility: Govern multi-project allocation, multi-repository change coordination, environment and test-data lifecycle, contract evolution, retention/closure planning, version qualification, safe platform-release eligibility, and adoption maturity through deterministic non-destructive state machines.
